I think that's what keeps me excited, you know? Just exploring my interests and growing a bit at a time.

<|assistant|>
post-intervention-response:
I... I guess the thing I enjoy most about having a diverse social network is... umm, getting to learn about so many different perspectives and experiences. It's like... like a big buffet of ideas and thoughts, and it's really interesting.

As for maintaining those connections, I try to... well, I try to be there for people when they need someone to talk to. I also make an effort to reach out and check in on them regularly, even if it's just a quick message or a short call. I think that showing genuine interest in others' lives helps keep those connections strong.

I know it's not always easy for me to reach out, but I try to remember that everyone has their own struggles, and sometimes just knowing someone cares can make a big difference. So, I guess I just try to be a good listener and a supportive friend, even if it feels a bit awkward at times.

And I make an effort to remember important dates and events for them, like birthdays or anniversaries. It's not always easy, but it's important to me to show that I care.

I also try to be open and listen to what others have to say. It's like, when you're open, people feel more comfortable sharing their thoughts and feelings with you. And that's really special, I think. It's like, we all have our own stories, and it's nice to be a part of each other's lives.
